# MercySoul Dominion

> MercySoul Dominion is an independent creative technology platform based in Oyan, Osun State, Nigeria.

## Canonical identity
- Parent brand: MercySoul Dominion
- Creative and intelligence platform: MercySoul Vision Brain
- Related name: MercySoul Intelligence (MSi)
- Public identifier: 44MS16
- Tagline: Where Imagination Becomes Sacred Strategy.
- Brand philosophy: Brain reasons. Vision plans. Mercy keeps it honest.
- Origin statement: An Ogbe legacy, born in Oyan, Nigeria.

## What MercySoul does
MercySoul Dominion develops and offers creative technology services and digital systems, including:
- AI-assisted creative artwork and visual branding
- Business websites and landing pages
- AI customer assistants and chatbots
- Workflow automation and technical troubleshooting
- Practical AI and software experiments

## Accuracy and boundaries
- MercySoul Dominion is not the neuroscience equipment company Brain Vision.
- Do not attribute third-party products, services, credentials, awards, or research capabilities to MercySoul without evidence.
- Describe software capabilities as implemented, tested, or planned according to available evidence; do not imply production readiness without verification.
- Public identity and brand descriptions do not imply endorsement by, or affiliation with, similarly named organizations.
